mean_box_wh — 2D smoothing op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "mean_box_wh", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: mean_image (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Averaging (box) filter with independently chosen width and height. Equivalent to HALCON's mean_image (Smooth by averaging.).

a is the window width and b the window height; each knob maps to the odd sizes 1, 3, …, 15 by 1 + 2 * min(7, int(8 * clip(knob, 0, 1))) (the same as rounding an even width or height up to the next odd value). Borders always use reflect. When width and height are equal the result is bit-identical to mean_box with the same window and reflect. Example: _mean_box_wh(np.eye(5), 0.2, 0.4).
